name: web-reader-mcp
description: Reads a web page or PDF the way an agent needs it: the main content without navigation or ads, as clean Markdown, with an outline to jump to sections, a query mode that returns only the passages that answer a question, in-page search and link lists. Refuses private and internal addresses, respects robots.txt, no key.

dependencyReasons.@mozilla/readability: Firefox Reader View's main-content extraction: separates the article from navigation, ads and footers, which no regex heuristic does reliably.
dependencyReasons.linkedom: A light server-side DOM for Readability and Turndown; jsdom does the same at twenty times the install size.
dependencyReasons.turndown: HTML to Markdown conversion with rules per element; writing a correct converter by hand would duplicate it.
dependencyReasons.turndown-plugin-gfm: GitHub-flavoured tables and strikethrough for Turndown, so tables stay tables instead of runs of text.
dependencyReasons.unpdf: Text from PDFs (a serverless build of Mozilla pdf.js); papers and reports are PDFs and have no other text source.
